WARRIOR — stands easy and certain, the way men who win usually do, presence settling the room before he says a word.
ASSASSIN — reads every exit and every blade in the room without seeming to look, still as water before it breaks.
RANGER — moves with the economy of someone who never wastes a motion, at home in any terrain and accountable to none.
WIZARD — absolute focus made visible, the kind of stillness that precedes something irreversible and precisely calculated.
PALADIN — commands space without demanding it, carrying a certainty so complete it functions like armor all on its own.
WARLOCK — calm in the particular way of someone who has already made the difficult trade and has no regrets about it.
KNIGHT — bearing built for authority, every posture a declaration that disorder ends exactly where he chooses it to end.
ROGUE — coiled readiness behind an easy manner, the dangerous kind of relaxed that only fools read as harmless.
DRUID — rooted and unhurried, a focused intensity that suggests the world rearranges itself around his patience rather than his effort.
BATTLEMAGE — controlled aggression and arcane discipline unified, the kind of man who solves problems completely and moves on without ceremony.
BARBARIAN — barely contained forward momentum, force held at threshold, the predator's calm of something that chooses not to strike yet.
NECROMANCER — precise and unreadable, approaching every situation with the clinical distance of someone for whom mortality is simply a variable.
HUNTER — predator's calm, reading the ground and the wind and the angle of light while appearing to do nothing at all.
INQUISITOR — stands with the settled authority of someone who already knows the answer and is deciding what to do with it.
SORCERER — power that moves through him rather than from him, effortless and slightly unsettling, like weather that has learned to think.
KNIGHT-ERRANT — self-possessed without allegiance, carrying purpose the way other men carry names, something-not-to-be-crossed wrapped in perfect composure.
SHADOWMANCER — occupies the edge of every space, present and half-absent simultaneously, a focused intensity that never lands where you expect.
TEMPLAR — uncompromising forward bearing, the kind of man who defines the line and has already decided what happens if it's crossed.
WARDEN — watchful and economical, accountability running deeper than rank, the quiet lethal control of someone who protects on his own terms.
HEXBLADE — still and deliberate, the particular confidence of a man whose power has been tested and passed in ways others cannot imagine.
MONK — coiled readiness expressed as perfect stillness, every breath accounted for, every motion a commitment made before the body executes it.
ARCANIST — commands arcane forces with the precision of a craftsman and the focus of someone who finds carelessness genuinely offensive.
DEATHKNIGHT — commanding presence stripped to its coldest essential, zero performance, zero threat display — only outcome, only certainty.
CHAMPION — occupies contested ground with the unshakeable confidence of a man who has already decided the fight ends in his favor.
SHAMAN — unhurried authority, the focused intensity of someone negotiating between forces most people cannot perceive, let alone survive addressing.
BERSERKER — controlled fury on a hair trigger, currently controlled; the potential for explosion is legible without him doing anything at all.
NIGHTBLADE — exists at the edge of a room the way a shadow does; present, functional, already positioned where he needs to be.
DEATH KNIGHT — radiates the particular authority of a man who crossed a threshold others only theorize about; cold, deliberate, sovereign.
SCOUT-KILLER — low profile, total awareness; the professional blankness of a man who has made an art of being underestimated right up until the precise moment he chooses not to be.
ELEMENTALIST — focused intensity that charges the atmosphere around him; holds himself with the contained discipline of someone managing enormous, impatient forces from the inside out.
CRUSADER — forward-facing and immovable, the kind of bearing that suggests he has already decided how this ends; commanding without performance, righteous without apology.
ORACLE — receives information others cannot access and carries it without drama; the unshakeable self-possession of someone who has already seen enough of what is coming to stop being surprised.
